methods.label: Eliminate B's money
methods.explanation:
The two statements translate to
\[
5a+b>51,
\qquad 3a-b=21.
\]
The opposite signs of \(b\) suggest adding the relations to eliminate it. Since the second expression equals \(21\), this gives
\[
(5a+b)+(3a-b)>51+21,
\]
so \(8a>72\) and therefore \(a>9\). The equation then gives
\[
b=3a-21>3\cdot9-21=6.
\]
Thus \(\boxed{a>9\text{ and }b>6}\), choice \(\mathrm{A}\).
